name: Cleanup After Trim Paint
intent: Final inspect cured trim, touch up any final defects, tear down floor protection and wall masking, clean tools. Final inspect is the most critical step because trim is high-visibility.

tasks.name: Final Inspect Trim Finish
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 600 LF/hr; slower than coat inspection because final inspection is more rigorous (looking for runs, holidays, lap marks, and any defects that will be visible to the customer).

tasks.name: Final Trim Touchup
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 1000 LF/hr because touchups are spot work on isolated defects (typically <5% of trim LF gets touched).

tasks.name: Clean Tools After Trim Paint
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 25 minutes (vs 20 for prime) because finish coat tools need more thorough cleaning to prevent oil-based residue cross-contamination on the next job.

doctrine: Several rates here are gap-filled (final inspect, final touchup, clean tools fixed time). The protection teardown rate (500 SF/hr) is from the source spec — slower than trim prime teardown (1500 SF/hr) for the same reason setup is slower: the painter is working around finished surfaces.
